channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Money for Nothing
channel.desc: Jacqui Joseph is at Altrincham Recycling Centre in Greater Manchester with an eagle eye, hoping to swoop in on quality items before they are lost forever. A mysterious wooden post leaves lighting designer Duncan scratching his head, and Jacqui tries to get a dated rocking chair back in full swing. Will she manage to send all three items off to new homes?
